description: This Java source file defines an immutable class 'MetadataFromSignal' responsible for creating, modifying, or extending Metadata objects based on signals and headers within a Ditto-based system. It provides methods for instantiating the class and generating metadata based on signal headers and existing metadata.

classes.name: MetadataFromSignal
classes.description: An immutable class that creates or extends Metadata objects based on a Signal's DittoHeaders and optional existing metadata. It provides static factory method 'of' for instantiation and implements Supplier<Metadata> for generating the resultant Metadata object.

methods.name: of
methods.description: Factory method to create a new instance of MetadataFromSignal with provided signal, withOptionalEntity, and existingMetadata.

methods.name: get
methods.description: Generates and returns the Metadata object based on the signal's headers and existing metadata. Returns null if no applicable headers or entity are present.

methods.name: getMetadataHeadersToPut
methods.description: Retrieves the set of MetadataHeaders to be applied from the signal's DittoHeaders.

methods.name: buildMetadata
methods.description: Constructs new Metadata by combining existing metadata and headers, based on the provided entity data.

methods.name: getMetadataBuilder
methods.description: Returns a MetadataBuilder initialized with existing metadata if available; otherwise, a new builder.

methods.name: addMetadataToLeaf
methods.description: Recursively adds metadata entries to leaf nodes in an entity JSON object, respecting field types and paths.
